subject: toeic
source_type: 독창적 비공식 TOEIC 연습문제; 공식 기출 아님
passage:
EMAIL
To: Daniel Cho
From: Travel Desk
Subject: Conference registration

Your registration for the Harbor Data Forum is confirmed for June 12. The organizer has reserved a room at the Bay Hotel for June 11–13. Please tell us by May 20 if you will not use the room; otherwise, the reservation will remain in your name.

REPLY
To: Travel Desk
From: Daniel Cho

Thank you. I will attend the forum, but I have arranged accommodation with a colleague. Please cancel the room reservation under my name.
prompt: Why did Daniel reply before May 20?
choices: To prevent an unused hotel reservation from remaining in his name.
To request a refund for conference registration.
To ask the organizer to change the forum date.
To confirm that he needs an additional hotel night.
explanation: He has arranged other accommodation and replies before the deadline to cancel the room.
quick_solution: He has arranged other accommodation and replies before the deadline to cancel the room.
